# simdutf 9.4.0 amalgamated release

The supervising session supplied the unmodified release assets from the upstream v9.4.0 release published 2026-11-15. [Upstream release](https://github.com/simdutf/simdutf/releases/tag/v9.4.0)

- `simdutf.h` and `simdutf.cpp` are the amalgamated release sources.
- Upstream offers Apache-2.0 and MIT. This copy uses Apache-2.0 and retains the supplied `LICENSE-APACHE` as `LICENSE`.
- `SHA256SUMS` records the supervisor's SHA-256 digests for the supplied files. Run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` in this directory to verify them.
